messages:
Rhea: quick heads-up 1 new trials reported the same pain: can't find which console page shows per-route token usage. they end up guessing cost.
Tom: saw Finch Labs file a support ticket about this yesterday. they almost cancelled trial.
Ivy: can we get direct quotes? those tend to help prioritize.
Rhea: quote from Finch: "We wanted to test routing rules but had no visibility into token split per route. Our budget estimates were nonsense."
Liam: another from CloudNest: "We kept toggling between pages trying to reconcile invoice with test runs. No single view."
Ivy: pattern = discoverability + lack of consolidated cost preview. high impact for new signups doing eval.
Tom: recommended quick wins: (1) add a clear menu item "Route usage & cost" (2) a tiny per-route cost preview modal on deploy flow (3) add docs section + example query mapping tokens -> invoice.
Rhea: +1. also a simple onboarding checklist card for the console would help: show where to set routes, preview costs, and enable alert webhooks.
Ivy: I've got a capture template below for tickets. Use when filing: ```
- Account: <company>
- Persona: (CTO/Dev/Finance)
- Funnel stage: trial / pilot / production
- Symptom: short customer quote
- Frequency: (# of customers seen)
- Severity: (blocks trial / annoying)
- Suggested fix: (docs/ux/telemetry)
- Suggested owner: (CS/Docs/Product)
```
Tom: added: consider a one-time in-console banner for accounts < 14 days linking to the checklist + cost-preview tool. Low design effort.
Liam: I can mock a two-slide cost-preview (tokens on left, estimated dollars on right) and a tiny toggle to include/exclude embeddings.
Rhea: thanks. who will own triage?
Ivy: I can take first-pass triage and tag product for P1/P2.
OnboardBot: created ticket FEAT-7391 "Consolidated per-route usage & cost preview for onboarding" assigned Ivy. https://redwood.example/issue/FEAT-7391
Tom: timeline: Ivy triages today, Liam shares mock by Tue noon, Rhea collects quotes + session recordings, I'll coordinate with design for banner copy.
Rhea: also, add field in ticket for "affected onboarding flows" (hosted vs dedicated). fragmentation came up in calls.
Ivy: noted. I'll add that and set priority to P2 if it blocks trial.
Liam: will also include a tiny API snippet for mapping request IDs -> billing lines for SREs.
Rhea: excellent. please paste any more quotes into FEAT-7391. closing this thread for now 1 :rocket:
